title: Glowing magic wand
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fffbe0' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='40%' stop-color='#ffe066' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff9900' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='starGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffffaa'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffdd44'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura behind star -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='28' r='28' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Wand stick -->
  <rect x='35' y='45' width='7' height='45' rx='3.5' fill='#c8873a'/>
  <rect x='35' y='45' width='3' height='45' rx='1.5' fill='#e8a85a'/>

  <!-- Wand handle band -->
  <rect x='33' y='82' width='11' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#8b4e1a'/>
  <rect x='33' y='82' width='11' height='2' rx='1' fill='#b06a2a'/>

  <!-- Star body -->
  <polygon points='55,8 60,22 75,22 63,31 68,45 55,36 42,45 47,31 35,22 50,22'
           fill='url(#starGlow)' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Star highlight -->
  <polygon points='55,14 58,23 68,23 60,29 63,38 55,32 47,38 50,29 42,23 52,23'
           fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Small sparkles -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='20' r='2.5' fill='#aaddff'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='15' r='2' fill='#aaddff'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='35' r='2.5' fill='#ccffaa'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='38' r='1.8' fill='#ffe0ff'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='48' r='1.8' fill='#aaddff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='12' r='1.5' fill='#ccffaa'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='24' r='1.5' fill='#ffe0ff'/>

  <!-- Tiny cross sparkles -->
  <g stroke='#aaddff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='22' y1='28' x2='26' y2='28'/>
    <line x1='24' y1='26' x2='24' y2='30'/>
    <line x1='84' y1='44' x2='88' y2='44'/>
    <line x1='86' y1='42' x2='86' y2='46'/>
  </g>
</svg>
